pages.title: Broths
pages.content: Four broths, all finished by dawn: Clear, Red, White and Forest. Any two share one split pot at no extra cost.

pages.title: Courses
pages.content: Five sets and two extras, priced per person. Every set comes with your split pot, a vegetable platter and the sauce bar.

pages.title: Private rooms
pages.content: Three private rooms upstairs for 2 to 14 guests, each with its own burners. Request one three days ahead.

pages.title: Book a table
pages.content: One way to book: choose the date, time and guests, send the request, and we confirm by email within three hours.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content: 14 Harbour Row, Wellmouth. Dinner Tue–Sun 17:00–22:30, lunch Sat–Sun 12:00–15:00, closed Monday.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Kosame Hot Pot opened in 2016 on Harbour Row. It rained on the first evening, and the name stuck: kosame is light rain.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content: Write to table@kosame-hotpot.example or call +44 1632 960 527. The booking desk answers Tue–Sun 14:00–22:00.

pages.title: The Pot Letter
pages.content: Once a month, on the first Tuesday: the month’s broth, open private-room dates and one recipe to cook at home.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content: We use your name, email and booking details only to answer your request. We do not sell or share them.

categories.name: From the kitchen
categories.description: Notes on broths, rooms and booking.

posts.title: Why the broth goes on at half past five
posts.excerpt: The stockpots go on at 05:30 so that four broths are finished by the time the first guest sits.
posts.content:
The stockpots go on at half past five because broth cannot be hurried. Chicken and kelp need six hours, the white broth twelve, and the red and forest broths a little less.

By the time the market delivery reaches the back door at 07:30 the first pots are already clear. Everything after that is skimming, tasting and waiting.

posts.title: Clear or red: how to split your pot
posts.excerpt: Any two of the four broths share one split pot at no extra cost. A short guide to pairing them.
posts.content:
Clear is light and golden; red carries beef fat, dried chilli and Sichuan pepper. Many tables start with one of each and move vegetables to the clear side when the red turns hot.

White and forest pair well with either. Ask your server and we will set the pot before you sit.

posts.title: Booking a room for twelve
posts.excerpt: Room Three seats ten to fourteen on one long table. How far ahead to ask and what to tell us.
posts.content:
Room Three seats ten to fourteen guests along a single long table with three pots. Request it at least three days ahead through the Book a table button.

Tell us the date, the time, how many are coming and any dietary notes. We confirm by email within three hours during desk hours.
